lines.quote: I bring strong capabilities in embedded DSP development in C and C++, which I consider essential for any engineer working on real-time instrument systems.
My production Python skills have also become a central part of how I work, from simulation frameworks to automated acceptance testing to deployment tooling.

requirements.name: RF measurement experience

lines.quote: My career at Boreal has been in photonic sensor systems, which is a domain that shares more with Kaikuvaara's work than it might appear on the surface.
And I have extensive RF measurement and characterisation experience that gives me the practical instinct for what a signal chain actually does versus what it should do on paper.

requirements.note: The letter frames the candidate's optical/photonic experience at Boreal Photonics (the sole employer listed) as transferable to RF by analogy ('the engineering behind it translates'), then separately claims extensive direct RF measurement and characterisation experience. Both statements are recorded without resolving whether the RF claim is direct experience or the stated analogy.
